ns2:course.label: Advanced Course in a Less Commonly Taught Language I
ns2:course.description: Advanced or intensive language instruction in a selected less commonly taught language. May be repeated with approval. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. May be repeated in separate semesters, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Departmental approval is required.
